policy: Fresh 10-case holdout. Reference labels fixed from publications distinct from engine-side evidence snapshots before engine execution. No production rule may be changed during scoring.

cases.reference_basis: 2022 systematic review/meta-analysis found BP lowering versus placebo but high heterogeneity and called for more studies to establish dose and duration.
2023 updated meta-analysis found significant SBP/DBP reductions, but very high heterogeneity and described prior findings as controversial.
Systematic review/meta-analysis found fennel significantly reduced dysmenorrhea intensity versus placebo and was not significantly different from mefenamic acid.
2023 systematic review/meta-analysis found reduction in hot-flash outcomes but only four studies, high heterogeneity, and recommended broader use only if confirmed by further investigations.
2025 systematic/meta-analytic synthesis found modest significant cardiometabolic improvements, supporting adjunctive rather than definitive therapy.
Meta-analysis found large pooled benefit but most trials had high risk of bias and heterogeneity was extremely high.
2025 meta-analysis found BP reduction but very high heterogeneity and explicitly urged careful interpretation and further high-quality RCTs.
Updated meta-analysis found improvements in several glycemic parameters but very high heterogeneity for some endpoints and requested higher-quality confirmation.
Systematic review found most trials reduced anxiety but effects were less evident in mild anxiety and trials were small/heterogeneous.
Systematic review/meta-analysis characterized clinical benefit as controversial and found evidence varied substantially by liver disease and endpoint.
